text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
"It was close, but you were amazing, 
Inari-chan! You were definitely one of the 
main stars of this race!"

text_block_list.name: Downtown Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... ugh...... sob......! So 
magnificent......!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
B-Biiig sissssteeeer... You looked so 
cooool!!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. That was really so close.

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Victory slipped away, huh... People might 
start seeing Inari One as an inconsistent 
Umamusume again, but—

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—You can still make a comeback. If you 
take a decisive, undeniable victory in the 
next showdown...! I know you can do it, 
right...!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Dammit, dammit, dammit! Curse it all!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I let it slip away...! First place... a 
complete victory...!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Uma Musume of the Year... is slipping 
away from me...!)
(WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Creeeeek!! Nice guts!! I believe in you, 
you won't lose next time!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Keep it up, Super Creek!! Your run wasn't 
beaten at all!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Everyone... Thank you all, truly.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
At the next Arima Kinen, I will definitely 
win right before everyone's eyes~!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Creek doesn't doubt it for a second. That 
she's at the "top"... and that she's 
definitely gonna win next time...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(And that must be... the same for Oguri 
too...—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, crap... dammit...! I know I'm 
supposed to do that too! So why the hell 
can't I stop thinking this way...?!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Creek and the others are... far better 
than me—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (――Talk about "stylish.")

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Please let me run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Creek's running in that one. Oguri 
definitely will too. And there, I'm 
gonna... beat 'em this time for sure.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Just beating one of them won't cut it. 
I've gotta... crush 'em all together...!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
To claim the "top"...! I've got no choice 
but to win...!

And so, we set our sights on the Arima 
Kinen to seek a rematch against Oguri Cap 
and the others...

A few days later. It happened during 
training—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ââHaa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ugh... *hic*...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Kh, I'm fine, Boss! Please, let me keep 
going!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Kh, I'm fine, Boss! Please, let me keep 
going!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, every single second counts...! 
I have to train harder, push even 
further—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Kh—

As Inari One fell forward, I managed to 
catch her just before she hit the 
ground...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...My bad. My foot slipped a bit back 
there—
choice_data_list: Let's just call it a day and rest...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I will! There's no way in hell 
I've got time to rest!! The Arima Kinen's 
right around the corner!!
choice_data_list:
You won't even be able to run before that 
happens!!

You won't even be able to run before that 
happens!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If I can't reach the "top," it's no 
different from not running at all!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I know Oguri and Creek are training at 
this very moment, trying to get ahead of 
me...!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The rivals we'll face at the Arima Kinen 
are bound to be way stronger than they 
were back at the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
To beat them fair and square and claim the 
top spot, of course I've gotta put my damn 
life on the line……!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'll carry... everyone's feelings...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I don't want it to... go to waste—

Just as Inari One managed to say that 
much, all the strength suddenly drained 
from her body and she nearly collapsed 
again. She was so exhausted this time that 
she couldn't even make a sound—

In the end, after being examined at the 
infirmary that day, Inari One was sent to 
rest in the dorms...

According to the examination, while 
physical fatigue played a part in her 
collapse, the main cause was psychogenic— 
brought on by various mental stresses.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Can't even train properly, and on top of 
that, collapsin' 'cause my heart gave 
out... What a joke...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Forget about taking the "top"... I can't 
even face everyone back home anymore...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
choice_data_list:
For now, let's just make sure you get 
proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …………Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ――Damn it.

...It was the first time I had ever seen 
Inari One so weakened. Every time I recall 
her expression, my heart aches.
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can do for you—
Is there anything I can do for you—

text_block_list.text:
...I won't ask for her to train again. 
Right now, I just want to cheer up her 
deeply weary heart.

So she can return to being the stylish, 
spirited Inari One she once was... What 
can I do as her partner—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho! Heave-ho!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, don't drop out now! 
Let's get this party hyped!!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let your voice out too! Heave-ho! 
Heave-ho!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The reason I can stay true to myself— and 
want to be a chic, spirited Edokko—is...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —It's all thanks to the folks in town.

—As memories with Inari One flash through 
my mind, one thing I can do for her 
becomes clear.

However, this might actually have the 
opposite effect on Inari One right now—

In Inari One's running, there had always 
been a bond with everyone from the old 
downtown district.
So right now... I'll bet on that!

"—That night, I steeled my resolve and 
contacted the master."

And... they discussed what they wanted to 
do for Inari One.
